lines: # Folder map
What each folder is for. Read this before adding a file.
- `script/`: Story text: outline.md and per-page scripts in script/pages/.
- `script/pages/`: One .md per page: panels, action, dialogue.
- `bible/`: World, tone, palette and style rules.
- `characters/`: One folder per character; copy _template/ (sheet/, read-only refs/).
- `characters/_template/`: Copy this to start a character.
- `characters/_template/sheet/`: Turnarounds, expressions, outfits.
- `characters/_template/refs/`: Read-only supplied reference for this character.
- `refs/`: Read-only style, location and prop references.
- `templates/`: Page size, bleed, safe area and panel grids.
- `fonts/`: Lettering fonts with their licence files.
- `thumbnails/`: Small page layouts for pacing and composition.
- `pages/`: Per-page folders (copy _template/: roughs, inks, colours, letters, assembly).
- `pages/_template/`: Copy this to start a page (p001, p002 ...).
- `pages/_template/roughs/`: Panel pencils or first-pass generations.
- `pages/_template/inks/`: Clean line art per panel.
- `pages/_template/colours/`: Flats and rendered colour per panel.
- `pages/_template/letters/`: Balloons, captions and SFX as editable layers.
- `pages/_template/assembly/`: Composed page working file.
- `gen/`: Ignored by Git, disposable raw AI generations in dated subfolders.
- `animatic/`: Storyboards only: timed panels with scratch audio.
- `review/`: Disposable marked-up pages and notes per review round.
- `export/`: Finished output by target: web/, print/ and book/.
- `export/web/`: RGB pages and vertical strips for screens.
- `export/print/`: High-res pages with bleed.
- `export/book/`: Assembled PDF, CBZ or EPUB.
# Outline
Story outline.

purpose: `{{project}}` is a comic and storyboard workspace.
Start a page by copying `pages/_template/` to `pages/pNNN/`, and a character by copying `characters/_template/`.
rules: - Each folder's purpose is in `FOLDERS.md`; read it before adding a file.
- Page folders in `pages/` are named `p` plus three digits (copy `pages/_template/`); panel files are `p001_pn01_<stage>.ext`.
- Work moves one way through each `pages/pNNN/` folder: `roughs/` → `inks/` → `colours/` → `letters/` → `assembly/`. Never edit an earlier stage's file from a later stage.
- Raw generations go in `gen/YYYY-MM-DD/`; copy the chosen one into `pages/pNNN/roughs/`.
- Dialogue comes from `script/pages/`; if art and script disagree, the script wins.
- A character's look comes from `characters/<name>/sheet/` (copied from `characters/_template/`); do not invent outfit or feature changes.
- Lettering stays on editable layers; never flatten text into art.
- Only fonts in `fonts/` may be used.
- Changing the script, a character sheet or the page count needs approval.
- Files in `export/` are rebuilt from `pages/pNNN/assembly/`, never edited by hand.
- Run `git lfs install` once before the first commit.
